chunks: We sent Noah to his people (saying): "I am to you a clear warner."

key_terms.قَوْمِهِ: His people, referring to the community he was sent to
key_terms.نَذِيرٌ: A warner, one who gives news of punishment
key_terms.نُوحًا: Noah (peace be upon him), the prophet

ai.seo_question: What was Noah's message to his people according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Hud, this verse establishes Noah as the archetype of the prophetic mission, emphasizing the clarity ('mubin') of his warning against idolatry. Shia scholarship often highlights this narrative as a precursor to the ultimate warning brought by the Prophet Muhammad and the Ahl al-Bayt, underscing the continuity of divine guidance. The term 'mubin' signifies not just a verbal warning but a manifest truth that leaves no excuse for denial, a theme central to Shia eschatology.
